Axis

Levels sit in columns by orbital l. NIST levels with a known J are drawn as side-by-side fine-structure bars, not to scale. QDT-model levels have no J and are drawn dotted at full width. Line weight follows log f. Wavelengths are vacuum values. ORCA markers are drawn at their exact energy, in the column of the nearest NIST multiplet. Click a line to select it, shift-click to add, double-click to isolate. Click a level or an ORCA marker to pin it. Drag on the plot to zoom into the dense Rydberg region and double-click to reset.
